author: Insta360
description:
Built for creators, vloggers, and everyday storytellers, Insta360 Snap transforms the way users capture themselves by utilizing their phone's rear camera, so they always look their best without sacrificing convenience. The device attaches magnetically to the back of a phone, providing a real-time preview of each shot. Instead of guessing, reframing, or reshooting over and over, users can see themselves clearly while using the phone's best camera.
